question: For each department that offered subjects in the Fall term of 2022, what is the department name, the highest number of lecture units among its offered subjects, the start date of the term, and the total number of subjects offered by that department in that term, considering only departments where the highest number of lecture units is greater than 3? SELECT 
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units,
    t.TERM_START_DATE,
    COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2022-2023'
GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_START_DATE
HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3
ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME

historical_programs.sql_template: WITH DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY units_variance DESC), PoliSciHGNStats AS (SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2), DeptSubjectTotals AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.avg_units, d.units_variance, NULL AS HGN_CODE, NULL AS max_lecture_units, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS total_subjects, 'DeptUnitsStats' AS Source FROM DeptUnitsStats AS d UNION ALL SELECT p.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_units, NULL AS units_variance, p.HGN_CODE, p.max_lecture_units, p.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS total_subjects, 'PoliSciHGNStats' AS Source FROM PoliSciHGNStats AS p UNION ALL SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_units, NULL AS units_variance, NULL AS HGN_CODE, NULL AS max_lecture_units, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, t.total_subjects, 'DeptSubjectTotals' AS Source FROM DeptSubjectTotals AS t) SELECT * FROM CombinedStats ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source

WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS c JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd JOIN `SIS_SUBJECT_CODE` AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN `CIS_COURSE_CATALOG` AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.min_total_units_per_dept, NULL AS COURSE_NUMBER, NULL AS OFFER_COUNT, '12-unit 2022 Degree-Granting Subject' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS COURSE_LEVEL, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS min_total_units_per_dept, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.offer_count, 'Top 3 Most Frequently Offered Mathematics Course' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, COURSE_LEVEL, SCHOOL_NAME, min_total_units_per_dept, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_COUNT, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ccso.LECTURE_UNITS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS tso JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics'), MathDeptUnitStats AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_range, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_variance FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` WHERE IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND NOT TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.LECTURE_UNITS, CASE WHEN NOT ccs.JOINT_SUBJECTS IS NULL AND TRIM(ccs.JOINT_SUBJECTS) <> '' THEN 'Y' ELSE 'N' END AS IS_JOINT_SUBJECT, mds.total_units_range, mds.total_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccs ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MathDeptUnitStats AS mds ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID

WITH student_info AS (SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM `MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY` AS msd JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), student_info_with_admin AS (SELECT si.FIRST_NAME, si.LAST_NAME, si.EMAIL_ADDRESS, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, si.SCHOOL_NAME, si.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM student_info AS si LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE), school_units_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units, VARIANCE(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS units_variance FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.avg_units) AS school_avg_units, VARIANCE(ic.avg_units) AS school_units_variance FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_CODE = d.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE NOT d.SCHOOL_CODE IN (SELECT SCHOOL_CODE FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` WHERE DEPARTMENT_CODE = '7') GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.STUDENT_YEAR, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, s.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sus.school_avg_units, sus.school_units_variance FROM student_info_with_admin AS s LEFT JOIN school_units_stats AS sus ON s.SCHOOL_NAME = sus.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY s.SCHOOL_NAME

WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.TOTAL_UNITS FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS cso WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND cso.IS_VARIABLE_UNITS = 'N' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Mathematics%') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, VARIANCE(TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME WITH ROLLUP HAVING NOT ACADEMIC_YEAR IS NULL ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_description, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_stats.subject_count_in_dept, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN `SUBJECT_SUMMARY` AS ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count_in_dept FROM `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = dept_stats.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT 'Department_Statistics' AS result_type, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.avg_total_units, s1.var_total_units, NULL AS term_description, NULL AS subject_code, NULL AS subject_number, NULL AS subject_title, NULL AS subject_rank_in_dept, NULL AS school_name, NULL AS subject_count_in_dept FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT 'Subject_Details' AS result_type, NULL AS academic_year, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS avg_total_units, NULL AS var_total_units, s2.term_description, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.subject_rank_in_dept, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.subject_count_in_dept FROM Subquery2 AS s2 ORDER BY result_type, academic_year, department_name, term_description, subject_code

WITH DeptBudgetStddev AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, STDDEV(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS dept_budget_code_stddev, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) - MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS range_total_units, VARIANCE(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS var_total_units FROM `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd JOIN `SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION` AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN `COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccso.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, d1.dept_budget_code_stddev, d1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d2.avg_total_units, d2.range_total_units, d2.var_total_units, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM DeptBudgetStddev AS d1 JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS d2 ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN `SIS_DEPARTMENT` AS sd ON d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN `SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT` AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME, d1.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM `TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED` AS t0 JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERMS` AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN `ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER` AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), DeptSubjectCounts AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION WITH ROLLUP HAVING COUNT(*) > 0), subject_offered_summary AS (SELECT CASE WHEN dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ict.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY END AS TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, CASE WHEN dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IS NULL THEN NULL ELSE ict.SUBJECT_TITLE END AS SUBJECT_TITLE, dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dsc.TERM_DESCRIPTION, dsc.num_subjects, ict.SUBJECT_ID FROM DeptSubjectCounts AS dsc LEFT JOIN inner_cte1 AS ict ON dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ict.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND dsc.TERM_DESCRIPTION = ict.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY dsc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ict.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(tm.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS total_new_shelf_price, td.SUBJECT_ID FROM `TIP_DETAIL` AS td JOIN `TIP_MATERIAL` AS tm ON td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE NOT tm.AUTHOR IS NULL AND tm.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = 'ISBN' GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT sos.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TERM_DESCRIPTION, sos.num_subjects, ic2.min_record_count, ic2.total_new_shelf_price FROM `SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY` AS sos LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 AS ic2 ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = ic2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sos.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY

SELECT 
    c.DEPARTMENT_NAME,
    MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units,
    t.TERM_START_DATE,
    COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS total_subjects
FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED c
JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE
WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2022-2023'
GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.TERM_START_DATE
HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3
ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME
